> [!WARNING]

> Legacy MIUI project. No longer updated. It's kept for MIUI 12–13 users. HyperOS users: see HyperOS Screenshot Mod. (it has device frames)

Features

  • Editor features unlocked
  • Device frames

    • Requirements

  • MIUI 12–13, Android 10 or newer
  • Magisk

    • Installation

  • Download the latest zip from [**Releases**](https://github.com/Mods-Center/Miui_Gallery_Mod/releases/latest).
  • Flash it in Magisk.
  • Reboot your device.
